name: lg_end_core_defeated
doc: Stands in for the oracle's lavos_core_defeated state (2026-10-14): 80 more segments of `3 x B, 20 x A every 12` through Lavos's core (loc 1DF), with the session's heals -- after a segment, any of the party's seats below 500 HP set to its max ($5E30 + $80 x seat := $5E32's; the battle's HP, a test fixture: the auto-player's A alone loses the core) after segments 0 (seats 0-2), 41 (seat 1), 48 and 65 (seat 0), as its log recorded. The core defeated: the WRAM of the session's state, byte for byte.
